caseName: Missouri ex rel. Johnson v. Clay
caseNameFull: MISSOURI ex rel. JOHNSON, ADMINISTRATRIX v. CLAY, SUPERINTENDENT OF DIVISION OF INSURANCE
attorneys: Walter A. Raymond for appellants., Thomas F. Eagleton, Attorney General of Missouri, Harry H. Kay, Special Assistant Attorney General, and John C. Baumann for Clay, and James M. Douglas and William G. Guerri for Aetna Insurance Co., appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motions to dismiss are granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
